titulo: Using dentro de for in / within / among (time and place)
subtitulo: Dentro de tres días; dentro de la música mexicana.
regla: Dentro de + length of time = in (time left until something happens): dentro de tres días. En + time = how long it takes: lo hice en media hora. Dentro de can also mean within / among in an abstract sense.

bloques.texto: **Dentro de** + a length of time means **in**, counting forward from now: how much time is **left** until something happens.
**En** + a length of time tells you **how long something takes**: **lo terminé en una hora**.

In everyday Mexican Spanish you'll also hear **en** for the future (**te veo en diez minutos**), influenced by English. **Dentro de** is the standard, more careful choice, and the one to use in writing.
Tip: **dentro de** = the countdown. **En** = the stopwatch.

lista.es: Nos vamos a Mazatlán ==dentro de== tres días.
lista.en: We're going to Mazatlán in three days.

lista.es: ==Dentro de== una semana tendremos los resultados.
lista.en: In a week we'll have the results.
We're getting married in a few hours!
I'll see you in ten minutes.
We decorated the cake in half an hour. (it took 30 minutes)

bloques.texto: **Dentro de** literally means _inside_ (**dentro de la caja**). With groups, fields or categories it means **within** or **among**:

lista.es: ==Dentro de== la música mexicana, tenemos el son, el mariachi y la banda, entre otros.
lista.en: Within Mexican music we have son, mariachi and banda, among others.

lista.es: ==Dentro de== la variedad de iglesias de Puebla, muchas son barrocas.
lista.en: Among the variety of churches in Puebla, many are Baroque.

lista.es: ==Dentro de== la cultura oaxaqueña, la Guelaguetza atrae a muchos turistas.
lista.en: Within Oaxacan culture, the Guelaguetza attracts many tourists.

filas.t: Lo hice dentro de dos horas.

lista.texto: Inside, the physical meaning: [[9510|dentro / dentro de]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _The movie starts in five minutes._
lista.r: La película empieza dentro de cinco minutos.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I read the book in two days._ (it took two days)
lista.r: Leí el libro en dos días.
